name: Tonatiuh
description:
When Adventure Experience increases: Convert 1 Elemental Die into Omni Element.
When Adventure Experience reaches 2: Draw 2 cards.
When Adventure Experience reaches 4: Your active character gains 2 stacks of Battle Plan.
When Adventure Experience reaches 6: Discard 1 random Summon on the opponent's side of the field, then summon Tide-Turning Sacred Lord and discard this card.
